027public class ProcurementMission extends HubMissionWithBarEvent {
028
029        public static float PROB_COMPLICATIONS = 0.5f;
030        
031        public static float MISSION_DAYS = 180f;
032        
033        public static float MIN_BASE_VALUE = 10000;
034        public static float MAX_BASE_VALUE = 100000;
035        public static float BASE_PRICE_MULT = 1.5f;
036        
037        public static float PROB_REMOTE = 0.5f;
038        
039        public static float PROB_BAR_UNDERWORLD = 0.25f;
040        public static float PROB_ILLEGAL_IF_UNDERWORLD = 0.5f;
041        public static float ILLEGAL_QUANTITY_MULT = 0.5f;
042        
043        
044        public static enum Stage {
045                TALK_TO_PERSON,
046                COMPLETED,
047                FAILED,
048        }
049        public static enum Variation {
050                LOCAL,
051                REMOTE,
052        }
053        
054        protected String commodityId;
055        protected int quantity;
056        protected int pricePerUnit;
057        
058        protected Variation variation;
059        protected MarketAPI deliveryMarket;
060        protected PersonAPI deliveryContact;
061        
062        
063        @Override
064        protected boolean create(MarketAPI createdAt, boolean barEvent) {
065                //genRandom = Misc.random;
066                if (barEvent) {
067                        if (rollProbability(PROB_BAR_UNDERWORLD)) {
068                                setGiverRank(Ranks.CITIZEN);
069                                setGiverPost(pickOne(Ranks.POST_SMUGGLER, Ranks.POST_GANGSTER, 
070                                                                         Ranks.POST_FENCE, Ranks.POST_CRIMINAL));
071                                setGiverImportance(pickImportance());
072                                setGiverTags(Tags.CONTACT_UNDERWORLD);
073                                setGiverFaction(Factions.PIRATES);
074                        } else {
075                                setGiverRank(Ranks.CITIZEN);
076                                String post = pickOne(Ranks.POST_TRADER, Ranks.POST_COMMODITIES_AGENT, 
077                                                                          Ranks.POST_MERCHANT, Ranks.POST_INVESTOR, 
078                                                                          Ranks.POST_EXECUTIVE, Ranks.POST_SENIOR_EXECUTIVE, 
079                                                                          Ranks.POST_PORTMASTER);
080                                setGiverPost(post);
081                                if (post.equals(Ranks.POST_SENIOR_EXECUTIVE)) {
082                                        setGiverImportance(pickHighImportance());
083                                } else {
084                                        setGiverImportance(pickImportance());
085                                }
086                                setGiverTags(Tags.CONTACT_TRADE);
087                        }
088                        findOrCreateGiver(createdAt, false, false);
089                }
090                
091                
092                PersonAPI person = getPerson();
093                if (person == null) return false;
094                MarketAPI market = person.getMarket();
095                if (market == null) return false;
096                
097                if (!setPersonMissionRef(person, "$proCom_ref")) {
098                        return false;
099                }
100                
101                if (barEvent) {
102                        setGiverIsPotentialContactOnSuccess();
103                }
104                
105                PersonImportance importance = person.getImportance();
106                boolean canOfferRemote = importance.ordinal() >= PersonImportance.MEDIUM.ordinal();
107                boolean preferExpensive = getQuality() >= PersonImportance.HIGH.getValue();
108                variation = Variation.LOCAL;
109                if (canOfferRemote && rollProbability(PROB_REMOTE)) {
110                        variation = Variation.REMOTE;
111                }
112                if (CheapCommodityMission.SAME_CONTACT_DEBUG) {
113                        variation = Variation.REMOTE;
114                }
115
116                CommodityOnMarketAPI com = null;
117                if (variation == Variation.LOCAL) {
118                        requireMarketIs(market);
119                        requireCommodityIsNotPersonnel();
120                        if (person.hasTag(Tags.CONTACT_UNDERWORLD) && rollProbability(PROB_ILLEGAL_IF_UNDERWORLD)) {
121                                preferCommodityIllegal();
122                        } else {
123                                requireCommodityLegal();
124                                requireCommodityDemandAtLeast(1);
125                        }
126                        requireCommoditySurplusAtMost(0);
127                        requireCommodityDeficitAtLeast(1);
128                        if (preferExpensive) {
129                                preferCommodityTags(ReqMode.ALL, Commodities.TAG_EXPENSIVE);
130                        }
131                        com = pickCommodity();
132                } 
133                
134                if (com == null && canOfferRemote) {
135                        variation = Variation.REMOTE;
136                }
137                
138                if (variation == Variation.REMOTE) {
139                        if (CheapCommodityMission.SAME_CONTACT_DEBUG) {
140                                requireMarketIs("jangala");
141                        } else {
142                                requireMarketIsNot(market);
143                        }
144                        requireMarketFaction(market.getFactionId());
145                        requireMarketNotHidden();
146                        requireMarketLocationNot(createdAt.getContainingLocation());
147                        requireCommodityIsNotPersonnel();
148                        if (person.hasTag(Tags.CONTACT_UNDERWORLD) && rollProbability(PROB_ILLEGAL_IF_UNDERWORLD)) {
149                                preferCommodityIllegal();
150                        } else {
151                                requireMarketFactionNotHostileTo(Factions.PLAYER);
152                                requireCommodityLegal();
153                                requireCommodityDemandAtLeast(1);
154                        }
155                        requireCommoditySurplusAtMost(0);
156                        requireCommodityDeficitAtLeast(1);
157                        if (preferExpensive) {
158                                preferCommodityTags(ReqMode.ALL, Commodities.TAG_EXPENSIVE);
159                        }
160                        com = pickCommodity();
161                }
162                
163                if (com == null) return false;
164                
165                deliveryMarket = com.getMarket();
166                
167                commodityId = com.getId();
168                
169                float value = MIN_BASE_VALUE + (MAX_BASE_VALUE - MIN_BASE_VALUE) * getQuality();
170                quantity = getRoundNumber(value / com.getCommodity().getBasePrice());
171                if (com.isIllegal()) {
172                        quantity *= ILLEGAL_QUANTITY_MULT;
173                }
174                
175                if (quantity < 10) quantity = 10;
176                pricePerUnit = (int) (com.getMarket().getSupplyPrice(com.getId(), quantity, true) / (float) quantity * 
177                                                          BASE_PRICE_MULT / getRewardMult());
178                pricePerUnit = getRoundNumber(pricePerUnit);
179                if (pricePerUnit < 2) pricePerUnit = 2;
180                
181                
182                if (variation == Variation.REMOTE) {
183                        if (com.isIllegal()) {
184                                deliveryContact = findOrCreateCriminal(deliveryMarket, true);
185                        } else {
186                                deliveryContact = findOrCreateTrader(deliveryMarket.getFactionId(), deliveryMarket, true);
187                        }
188                } else {
189                        deliveryContact = person;
190                }
191                ensurePersonIsInCommDirectory(deliveryMarket, deliveryContact);
192                //setPersonIsPotentialContactOnSuccess(deliveryContact);
193                
194                if (deliveryContact == null ||
195                                (variation == Variation.REMOTE && !setPersonMissionRef(deliveryContact, "$proCom_ref"))) {
196                        return false;
197                }
198                setPersonDoGenericPortAuthorityCheck(deliveryContact);
199                makeImportant(deliveryContact, "$proCom_needsCommodity", Stage.TALK_TO_PERSON);
200                
201                setStartingStage(Stage.TALK_TO_PERSON);
202                setSuccessStage(Stage.COMPLETED);
203                setFailureStage(Stage.FAILED);
204                
205                setStageOnMemoryFlag(Stage.COMPLETED, deliveryContact, "$proCom_completed");
206                setTimeLimit(Stage.FAILED, MISSION_DAYS, null);
207                
208                
209                if (getQuality() < 0.5f) {
210                        setRepFactionChangesVeryLow();
211                } else {
212                        setRepFactionChangesLow();
213                }
214                setRepPersonChangesMedium();
215                
216                return true;
217        }
218        
219        protected void updateInteractionDataImpl() {
220                set("$proCom_barEvent", isBarEvent());
221                
222                set("$proCom_commodityId", commodityId);
223                set("$proCom_underworld", getPerson().hasTag(Tags.CONTACT_UNDERWORLD));
224                set("$proCom_playerHasEnough", playerHasEnough(commodityId, quantity));
225                set("$proCom_commodityName", getSpec().getLowerCaseName());
226                set("$proCom_quantity", Misc.getWithDGS(quantity));
227                set("$proCom_pricePerUnit", Misc.getDGSCredits(pricePerUnit));
228                set("$proCom_totalPrice", Misc.getDGSCredits(pricePerUnit * quantity));
229                set("$proCom_variation", variation);
230                set("$proCom_manOrWoman", getPerson().getManOrWoman());
231                //set("$proCom_heOrShe", getPerson().getHeOrShe());
232                //set("$proCom_HeOrShe", getPerson().getHeOrShe().substring(0, 1).toUpperCase() + getPerson().getHeOrShe().substring(1));
233                
234                
235                if (variation == Variation.REMOTE) {
236                        set("$proCom_personName", deliveryContact.getNameString());
237                        set("$proCom_personPost", deliveryContact.getPost().toLowerCase());
238                        set("$proCom_PersonPost", Misc.ucFirst(deliveryContact.getPost()));
239                        set("$proCom_marketName", deliveryMarket.getName());
240                        set("$proCom_marketOnOrAt", deliveryMarket.getOnOrAt());
241                        set("$proCom_dist", getDistanceLY(deliveryMarket));
242                }
243        }
244        
245        @Override
246        public void addDescriptionForNonEndStage(TooltipMakerAPI info, float width, float height) {
247                float opad = 10f;
248                Color h = Misc.getHighlightColor();
249                if (currentStage == Stage.TALK_TO_PERSON) {
250                        TooltipMakerAPI text = info.beginImageWithText(deliveryContact.getPortraitSprite(), 48f);
251                        text.addPara("Deliver %s units of " + getSpec().getLowerCaseName() + " to " + deliveryContact.getNameString() + " " +
252                                        deliveryMarket.getOnOrAt() + " " + deliveryMarket.getName() + ". You will be paid %s per unit, or " + 
253                                        "%s total.", 0f, h,
254                                        Misc.getWithDGS(quantity),
255                                        Misc.getDGSCredits(pricePerUnit), 
256                                        Misc.getDGSCredits(pricePerUnit * quantity));
257                        info.addImageWithText(opad);
258                        if (playerHasEnough(commodityId, quantity)) {
259                                info.addPara("You have enough " + getSpec().getLowerCaseName() + " in your cargo holds to complete " +
260                                                "the delivery.", opad);
261                        } else {
262                                info.addPara("You do not have enough " + getSpec().getLowerCaseName() + " in your cargo holds to complete " +
263                                                "the delivery.", opad);
264                        }
265                }
266        }
267
268//      need to mention that need to acquire the item
269//      check whether player has enough and chance desc/bullet point depending?
270        
271        @Override
272        public boolean addNextStepText(TooltipMakerAPI info, Color tc, float pad) {
273                Color h = Misc.getHighlightColor();
274                if (currentStage == Stage.TALK_TO_PERSON) {
275                        if (playerHasEnough(commodityId, quantity)) {
276                                info.addPara("Go to " + deliveryMarket.getName() + " and contact " + deliveryContact.getNameString() + " to arrange delivery", tc, pad);
277                        } else {
278                                String name = getSpec().getLowerCaseName();
279                                info.addPara("Acquire %s units of " + name, pad, tc, h, "" + (int) quantity);                           
280                        }
281                        return true;
282                }
283                return false;
284        }       
285        
286        @Override
287        public String getBaseName() {
288                return getSpec().getName() + " Procurement";
289        }
290        
291        @Override
292        public void accept(InteractionDialogAPI dialog, Map<String, MemoryAPI> memoryMap) {
293                super.accept(dialog, memoryMap);
294                
295                if (variation == Variation.REMOTE && rollProbability(PROB_COMPLICATIONS)) {
296                        DelayedFleetEncounter e = new DelayedFleetEncounter(genRandom, getMissionId());
297                        e.setDelay(10f);
298                        e.setLocationCoreOnly(true, Factions.PIRATES);
299                        e.setEncounterInHyper();
300                        e.beginCreate();
301                        e.triggerCreateFleet(FleetSize.MEDIUM, FleetQuality.DEFAULT, Factions.PIRATES, FleetTypes.PATROL_MEDIUM, new Vector2f());
302                        e.triggerSetAdjustStrengthBasedOnQuality(true, getQuality());
303                        e.triggerSetStandardAggroPirateFlags();
304                        e.triggerSetStandardAggroInterceptFlags();
305                        e.triggerSetFleetMemoryValue("$proCom_commodityName", getSpec().getLowerCaseName());
306                        e.triggerSetFleetGenericHailPermanent("PROCOMPirateHail");
307                        e.endCreate();
308                }
309        }

313        protected transient CommoditySpecAPI spec;
314        protected CommoditySpecAPI getSpec() {
315                if (spec == null) {
316                        spec = Global.getSettings().getCommoditySpec(commodityId);
317                }
318                return spec;
319        }
